subject: Aligning phased payment ladder, credit program & invoice timing for Medisphere
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@medisphere.it>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, procurement@medisphere.it
Cc: Luca Bianchi <luca.bianchi@medisphere.it>
Date: Fri, 09 Apr 2027 14:03:00 +0200
Subject: Request: Net60 + expanded credit for pilot & VAT handling

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team is keen to move forward. A couple of constraints on our side that will determine the contract cadence: our treasury runs on a 60-day payment cycle and legal prefers consolidated monthly invoices. Given the initial spend profile, would Redwood consider Net60 for the first 3 months and a conditional credit line of €250,000 tied to the signed SOW?

From a tax perspective, we need clarity on VAT treatment (invoicing to Medisphere Italy). If reverse-charge applies, we will provide our EU VAT ID and legal documentation. If Redwood must bill with VAT, we need the VAT amount split to reconcile with our ERP.

Can you send a proposed invoice schedule (dates and net days) and the documentation you need from our side to enable Net60 and the credit buffer? We can share bank references and a purchase order if that helps.

Best,
Elena Rossi
Head of Procurement
Medisphere Health

Attachments: none (will provide VAT/PO on receipt of proposed schedule)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@medisphere.it>
Cc: Luca Bianchi <luca.bianchi@medisphere.it>, karthik.iyer@redwood.com, naomi.feldman@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 09 Apr 2027 16:21:00 +0200
Subject: RE: Request: Net60 + expanded credit for pilot & VAT handling

Hi Elena — great to hear the team is ready to proceed. I put together a pragmatic, credit-safe proposal so we can balance Medisphere’s treasury cadence with Redwood’s credit controls (attached). High level:

- Deposit: 20% due on countersigned SOW (invoice 1)
- Pilot invoice cadence: Invoice 2 — milestone invoice due Net30 after delivery of pilot report
- Ramp/Subscription invoices: Invoice 3 onward — Net60 for first 90 days (as requested) with an initial credit cap of €150,000; automatic credit increase to €250,000 after 90 days of on-time payments and a bank reference review
- Early-pay options: 2% discount if paid within 10 days (can be applied to one invoice per quarter)

VAT and invoicing notes:
- If Medisphere provides a valid EU VAT ID and reverse-charge applies, we will issue invoices without Italian VAT to the entity you specify. Please send VAT ID + company registry extract.
- If you require Redwood EU entity billing with VAT, invoices will show VAT and we will provide the tax breakdown for your ERP reconciliation.

Required paperwork to enable Net60/credit buffer: signed SOW, completed credit application (attached template), one bank/trade reference, and PO number. Karhtik from finance is looped in for any stricter underwriting steps.

Next steps: If this structure looks acceptable, please countersign the SOW (I’ve attached a redline-friendly PDF) and return VAT evidence + PO. We’ll run the credit app in parallel and aim to have credit decision in 3–5 business days.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if you want to walk through the payment ladder.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

Attachments: 2027-04-09_MediSphere_PROPOSED_PAYMENT_PLAN.xlsx, Redwood_Credit_Application_TEMPLATE.xlsx
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@medisphere.it>
Cc: naomi.feldman@redwood.com, sean.gallagher@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 10 Apr 2027 09:12:00 +0200
Subject: RE: Request: Net60 + expanded credit for pilot & VAT handling

Hi Elena / Marissa — Karthik here (Finance). Two quick policy notes and a counter-proposal to accelerate onboarding while protecting both parties:

1) Standard underwriting: for Net60 we require (a) completed credit application, (b) one bank/trade reference, and (c) a PO anchored to the signed SOW. We can accept EU bank references in English.

2) Alternative to full Net60 from day one: we can offer a graduated term schedule — Net45 for month 1 (post-signature), Net60 for month 2–3, and then review for full Net60 going forward. This reduces our exposure up-front and usually aligns with how finance teams approve credit limits.

3) Credit cap: we are comfortable with an initial credit corridor of €150k, with an automatic review and potential increase to €250k after 90 days of clean payment performance and receipt of two trade/bank references. If Medisphere needs the higher cap immediately, we can consider a short-term guarantee or advance deposit equal to 10% of the requested cap.

4) VAT: to apply reverse-charge we need your VAT ID, company registration extract, and confirmation of the billed legal entity. If any invoices must include Italian VAT, please confirm the billing entity and we will add the tax.

Attached is a one-page checklist for documentation we need to complete the underwriting. Once we have the completed credit app + PO, we can issue the first invoice and set the agreed cadence.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Finance Manager, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com

Attachments: Redwood_Credit_Application_TEMPLATE.xlsx (resubmitted), Credit_Onboarding_Checklist.pdf
From: Luca Bianchi <luca.bianchi@medisphere.it>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@medisphere.it>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 11:48:00 +0200
Subject: RE: Request: Net60 + expanded credit for pilot & VAT handling

Marissa / Karthik — thanks for the clear proposal and the checklist. We are aligned on most items. Quick confirmations from our side:

- We will sign the SOW and return it today (attached).
- We can provide the EU VAT ID and company registration extract by end of day; reverse-charge is applicable for the service (we will confirm exact billing entity in the VAT docs).
- Regarding invoice timing: would Redwood consider invoice 2 as Net30 (pilot report milestone) rather than Net45? Our internal approvals are stricter on milestone payments and we can commit to Net60 on ongoing subscription invoices. The hybrid you proposed otherwise looks workable.
- We will send one bank reference (English) and the PO number along with the signed SOW.

If you can accept the small tweak (invoice 2 = Net30), we will return all paperwork by EOD and ask treasury to process the initial deposit immediately once the invoice is generated.

Thanks — Luca Bianchi
Procurement Manager
Medisphere Health

Attachments: Medisphere_Signed_SOW_v2.pdf
